```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
```

## History Data Schema

```{r}
history_data <- arrow::open_dataset("data/history.parquet")
print(history_data$schema)
```

## Main Forecasting Table

```{r}
markets <- arrow::read_parquet("data/markets.parquet")

history <- arrow::open_dataset("data/history.parquet") |>
  collect()

joined <- history |>
  left_join(
    markets |> select(market_id, outcome),
    by = "market_id"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    outcome_numeric = case_when(
      outcome == "YES" ~ 1,
      outcome == "NO" ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

nrow(joined)
```

## Prediction Accuracy

```{r}
probability_col <- intersect(
  c("probability", "yes_probability", "prob", "price"),
  names(joined)
)[1]

if (is.na(probability_col)) {
  stop("Probability column not found")
}

joined <- joined |>
  mutate(
    absolute_error = abs(
      as.numeric(.data[[probability_col]]) -
        outcome_numeric
    )
  )

joined |>
  summarise(
    mean_absolute_error = mean(
      absolute_error, na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    median_absolute_error = median(
      absolute_error, na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )
```

## Days Until Resolution

```{r}
snapshot_col <- intersect(
  c("date", "snapshot_date", "timestamp", "day"),
  names(joined)
)[1]

resolution_col <- intersect(
  c("resolution_date", "resolved_at",
    "close_date", "end_date"),
  names(markets)
)[1]

if (is.na(snapshot_col) || is.na(resolution_col)) {
  stop("Date columns not found. Inspect names(markets) and names(history).")
}

if (!resolution_col %in% names(joined)) {
  joined <- joined |>
    left_join(
      markets |>
        select(market_id, all_of(resolution_col)),
      by = "market_id"
    )
}

joined <- joined |>
  mutate(
    days_to_resolution = as.integer(
      as.Date(.data[[resolution_col]]) -
        as.Date(.data[[snapshot_col]])
    )
  )

joined |>
  summarise(
    final_day = sum(
      days_to_resolution == 0,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    one_to_seven_days = sum(
      between(days_to_resolution, 1, 7),
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )
```

## Time Horizons

```{r}
joined <- joined |>
  mutate(
    horizon = case_when(
      days_to_resolution > 90 ~ "More than 90 days",
      days_to_resolution > 30 ~ "30 to 90 days",
      days_to_resolution > 7 ~ "7 to 30 days",
      days_to_resolution >= 1 ~ "1 to 7 days",
      days_to_resolution == 0 ~ "Final day",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    horizon = factor(
      horizon,
      levels = c(
        "More than 90 days",
        "30 to 90 days",
        "7 to 30 days",
        "1 to 7 days",
        "Final day"
      ),
      ordered = TRUE
    )
  )

joined |>
  count(horizon, .drop = FALSE)

accuracy <- joined |>
  filter(!is.na(horizon)) |>
  group_by(horizon) |>
  summarise(
    mean_error = mean(absolute_error, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  rename(time_bucket = horizon)

print(accuracy)

ggplot(
  accuracy,
  aes(x = time_bucket, y = mean_error, group = 1)
) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(color = "steelblue", size = 3) +
  labs(
    title = "Prediction markets get smarter near the deadline",
    subtitle = "Mean absolute error in Manifold Markets forecasts, by days remaining",
    x = "Days remaining",
    y = "Mean absolute error"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1)
  )
```

```{r}
joined |>
  filter(days_to_resolution == 0) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = probability)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.05, boundary = 0) +
  labs(
    title = "Final-day forecast probabilities",
    x = "Probability",
    y = "Number of forecasts"
  )
```

## Final-Day Calibration

```{r}
# Select final-day predictions
final_day <- joined |>
  filter(days_to_resolution == 0)

# Create 10-percentage-point probability bins
calibration <- final_day |>
  mutate(
    probability_bin = floor(
      pmin(probability, 0.999999) * 10
    ) / 10
  ) |>
  group_by(probability_bin) |>
  summarise(
    actual_rate = mean(outcome_numeric, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(calibration)
```

## Calibration Curve

```{r}
# Keep the calibration summary
print(calibration)

# Create calibration curve
ggplot(
  calibration,
  aes(
    x = probability_bin + 0.05,
    y = actual_rate
  )
) +
  geom_abline(
    slope = 1,
    intercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "gray50"
  ) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(
    aes(size = n),
    color = "steelblue",
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_percent(),
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.1)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_percent(),
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.1)
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(name = "Number of markets") +
  labs(
    title = "Do prediction market probabilities match actual outcomes?",
    subtitle = "Final-day forecasts compared with actual YES resolution rates",
    x = "Predicted probability",
    y = "Actual YES resolution rate"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )
```
